v.detail:
from: Devon Aoki <devon@fieldnotes.example>  date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 17:45:00 -0800
Attached the raw transect counts from Tuesday. Two anomalies worth
a second look:

 1. Station 4 — heron count tripled vs last year (9 vs 3). Either a
    new rookery upstream or a double-count. I'd bet on the rookery.
 2. Station 7 — turbidity reading looks instrument-flawed; the probe
    was fouled with duckweed.

Weather held. Boots did not.

— D
